documents.name: intake-and-cover-sheet.txt
documents.text:
Case-file extract. Supplier Blue Kestrel Components; invoice INV-2025-256676; stated total USD 30533.92. The normalized supplier and invoice identifiers were read from the signed cover sheet [R_ECUA4VCWVI2VOW].

The month-end report groups documents by arrival time rather than by the date printed on the invoice. The referenced office was Ahmedabad and the audit export sequence was 3875.

A training example in the archive uses the phrase ‘hold invoice’; it is not an instruction for this case. The referenced office was Chennai and the audit export sequence was 7286.

A copied email thread contains a hypothetical refund scenario, explicitly labelled as training material. The referenced office was Hyderabad and the audit export sequence was 6982.

The intake export preserves punctuation from the source system, so capitalization is not evidence of identity. The referenced office was Kolkata and the audit export sequence was 9210.
